designDecisions: MAPPING SETTLED-BY-DEFAULT: sVis = planetRadiusEarth^0.5 normalized to 1 at 1 RE. VIS_SCALE_EXP is ONE lab constant, UAT-tunable; do not invent additional knobs.
CAMERA SETTLED: camera distance stays ABSOLUTE (state.distance * R). Scaling distance in planet-radii would exactly cancel the visual effect and is barred.

FENCE (hard): sVis is display-only. It must not appear in any procgen, height, schedule, featureFrequencyFromKm, or headless-harness path. Goldens 83/83 byte-identical, full suite at the exact 4-failure baseline.
AT 1 RE, ZERO CHANGE: sVis(1)=1 exactly; lodRampOf/autoOctaves/lodHysteresis inputs unchanged at sVis=1 (bit-identical frame behavior for every canonical-radius preset).
Crystal excluded from all staging/evidence/UAT presentation (parking lot, Max standing directive #2, 2026-07-24).
Known non-goal carried into the UAT recipe verbatim: craters render bigger WITH the disc (angular sizes mesh-floor R-invariant); 'bigger world -> relatively smaller craters' is NOT this increment.
